name: Jayo
summary: Budget AliExpress/Amazon filament label sold through its own storefronts, positioned as a cheaper alternative to Sunlu-branded product. Jayo is not a factory: its filament is manufactured by Sunlu, so its material originates from Sunlu's Chinese production bases.

oem_relationships.notes: User-verified (research/verified-oem-relationships.md). Community and review sources independently describe Jayo as a lower-priced Sunlu manufacturing sibling, consistent with the owner-verified relationship.

product_lines.name: PLA family
product_lines.notes: PLA, PLA+, PLA Meta, Silk PLA — mirrors Sunlu's material range, consistent with shared production

additional_notes: Storefronts: Amazon https://www.amazon.com/stores/JAYO/ and AliExpress https://www.aliexpress.com/store/1103589253 (a second AliExpress store, https://www.aliexpress.com/store/911431006, trades as '3DJAYO'). Typical pricing $10-18/kg, commonly on 1.1 kg spools. Third-party reviews (filamentcheatsheet Tier B) report consistent quality with some batch variability, notably in white and silk colours. manufacturing_countries reflects Sunlu's Chinese factories rather than any Jayo-owned plant. Build plates: none found.

provenance.conflicts: No legal entity behind the Jayo brand was independently confirmed; it operates as 'JAYO Official Store'/'jayo3d'. Two separate AliExpress storefronts are associated with the brand and it is unverified whether both are official.
